_meta.notes: Comprehensive index for Gambia covering Senegambia, Kunta Kinte heritage, British colony, Jammeh dictatorship, and 2016 crisis.

ethnic_groups.name: Mandinka (Mandingo/Malinke)
ethnic_groups.notes: Mande people; largest group; dominant in central and eastern Gambia; Muslim; historical Mali Empire links

ethnic_groups.name: Fula/Fulani (Fula/Pulaar)
ethnic_groups.notes: Historically pastoralist; now mainly settled agriculturalists; Muslim; widespread across West Africa

ethnic_groups.name: Wolof
ethnic_groups.notes: Urban and coastal; Banjul and Kombo; strong commercial presence; Wolof language is lingua franca in Senegal

ethnic_groups.name: Jola (Diola)
ethnic_groups.notes: Western and southern Gambia; Casamance region heritage; rice cultivation; some Christian minority

ethnic_groups.name: Serahule/Soninke
ethnic_groups.notes: Upper River Region; descendants of Ghana Empire; merchant tradition

ethnic_groups.name: Serer
ethnic_groups.notes: Cross-border with Senegal; historically resistant to Islamisation; strong ethnic identity

ethnic_groups.name: Aku (Creoles/Krio)
ethnic_groups.notes: Liberated slave descendants from Sierra Leone; English-speaking Christian community; historically influential in colonial administration

current_leader.name: Adama Barrow
current_leader.title: President
current_leader.notes: Ended Jammeh's 22-year rule; coalition candidate in 2016; re-elected 2021 with own NPP party

former_presidents.name: Dawda Jawara
former_presidents.notes: First president (PM 1965–1970); Westminster democracy; ousted in bloodless coup by Jammeh

former_presidents.name: Yahya Jammeh
former_presidents.notes: Military dictator; refused to accept 2016 election loss; ECOWAS intervention; exile in Equatorial Guinea; TRRC investigations into crimes

910.name: Prehistoric Gambia and Megaliths
910.description: Stone circles of Senegambia; early settlement along the Gambia River.

sub_clusters.name: Senegambian Stone Circles
sub_clusters.description: UNESCO World Heritage megalithic complexes at Wassu and Kerbatch; burial monuments.

sub_clusters.name: Early Gambia River Settlement
sub_clusters.description: Communities settle along the Gambia River; fishing and early agriculture.

920.name: Senegambian Kingdoms
920.description: Ghana Empire periphery; Mandinka expansion; Jolof, Kaabu influence along the Gambia.

sub_clusters.name: Mandinka Settlement
sub_clusters.description: Mali Empire traders and settlers along the Gambia River; Mandinka become dominant group.

sub_clusters.name: Kaabu Empire Influence
sub_clusters.description: Kaabu (Gabu) province of Mali Empire extends authority over Gambia River region.

930.name: European Contact and Slave Trade
930.description: Portuguese arrival; English trading posts; James Island slave depot; Kunta Kinte story.

sub_clusters.name: Portuguese Exploration
sub_clusters.description: Cadamosto explores Gambia River 1455; Portuguese trading posts established.

sub_clusters.name: James Island and the Slave Trade
sub_clusters.description: English fort on James Island; major slave embarkation point; Kunta Kinte legacy.

sub_clusters.name: Kunta Kinte and Roots Heritage
sub_clusters.description: Juffureh village; Kunta Kinte story popularised by Alex Haley's Roots (1976); cultural tourism.

930.name: Senegambian Jihads and Soninke-Marabout Wars
930.description: Islamic reform movements; Soninke-Marabout wars along the Gambia River.

sub_clusters.name: Soninke-Marabout Wars
sub_clusters.description: Conflicts between traditional rulers and Muslim reformers; reshapes political landscape.

sub_clusters.name: Maba Diakhou Bâ Jihad
sub_clusters.description: Maba Diakhou Bâ's jihad in Saloum; impacts Gambia region; killed 1867.

940.name: British Gambia Colony and Protectorate
940.description: Bathurst founded; Crown Colony; protectorate; groundnut monoculture; path to independence.

sub_clusters.name: Bathurst (Banjul) Founded
sub_clusters.description: Captain Alexander Grant establishes Bathurst to suppress slave trade; becomes colonial capital.

sub_clusters.name: Crown Colony and Protectorate
sub_clusters.description: Colony (Bathurst) and Protectorate (hinterland); groundnut economy; minimal development.

sub_clusters.name: Path to Independence
sub_clusters.description: Dawda Jawara and PPP; internal self-government 1963; independence 18 February 1965.

950.name: Jawara Republic
950.description: Dawda Jawara presidency; republic 1970; 1981 coup attempt; Senegambia Confederation.

sub_clusters.name: Jawara Presidency
sub_clusters.description: Multi-party democracy; groundnut dependency; reputation as stable democracy.

sub_clusters.name: Senegambia Confederation
sub_clusters.description: Confederation with Senegal after 1981 coup attempt; Senegalese troops intervene; dissolved 1989.

sub_clusters.name: 1994 Military Coup
sub_clusters.description: Lt. Yahya Jammeh overthrows Jawara in bloodless coup; Armed Forces Provisional Ruling Council.

960.name: Jammeh Dictatorship
960.description: Jammeh's authoritarian rule; human rights abuses; faith-healing claims; 2016 election crisis.

sub_clusters.name: Jammeh Authoritarian Rule
sub_clusters.description: Elected president 1996; increasingly repressive; disappearances; anti-gay persecution; claim to cure HIV.

sub_clusters.name: 2016 Election Crisis
sub_clusters.description: Adama Barrow defeats Jammeh; Jammeh refuses to leave; ECOWAS military intervention threat; exile.

960.name: Barrow Era and Democratic Transition
960.description: Adama Barrow presidency; TRRC truth commission; new constitution process; reconciliation.

sub_clusters.name: Truth, Reconciliation and Reparations Commission
sub_clusters.description: TRRC investigates Jammeh-era human rights abuses; testimonies; reparation recommendations.

sub_clusters.name: Third Republic and Constitution
sub_clusters.description: Draft new constitution; Barrow wins 2021 re-election; Jammeh extradition debates.

unassigned_events.note: Events not yet assigned to a thematic cluster
